title: Longest Repeating Substring
summary: For a given string, determine the length of the longest substring that repeats.
statement: For a given string, determine the length of the longest substring that repeats. If no such substring is found, report a length of zero.
constraints: Return the maximum repeated substring length, or zero.
reference_solution:
def longest_repeating_substring_length(s):
 low,high=0,len(s)-1
 while low<high:
  middle=(low+high+1)//2;seen=set();found=False
  for i in range(len(s)-middle+1):
   part=s[i:i+middle]
   if part in seen:found=True;break
   seen.add(part)
  if found:low=middle
  else:high=middle-1
 return low
